’Twas grwwdwd, and the plooox bbbles
      Did gyre and gimble in the wabe:
All snwwwwwwy were the cacacacacaats,
      And the mome raths outgrabe.

“Beware the GrozzlewumxxxXXp, my son!
      The jaws that bite, the claws that catch!
Beware the Jubjub bird, and shun
      The blustrous Quillersnap!”

He took his zindle sword in hand;
      Long time the blorish foe he sought—
So rested he by the Wimwam tree
      And stood awhile in thought.

And, as in ogglish thought he stood,
      The GrozzlewumxxxXXp, with eyes of flame,
Came snorfling through the brimsy wood,
      And burbled as it came!

One, two! One, two! And through and through
      The zindle blade went snicker-snack!
He left it dead, and with its head
      He went skrambling back.

“And hast thou slain the GrozzlewumxxxXXp?
      Come to my arms, my glimsy boy!
O snazzlous day! Fallooh! Fallay!”
      He chortled in his joy.

’Twas grwwdwd, and the plooox bbbles
      Did gyre and gimble in the wabe:
All snwwwwwwy were the cacacacacaats,
      And the mome raths outgrabe.
